reviewer.actual_role: TC method reviewer; owner of runtime TC case authoring
reviewer.review_type: Exact-SHA bounded method review; static source inspection only

review_scope: Reviewed v2 cleanup deadline propagation, complete H2 fixture finalizer closure, restarted PostgreSQL identity, multi-generation attempt ordering, unchanged historical semantics, and full-gate qualification. This approves authoring of the specified fixture integration only; it is not execution approval or runtime evidence.

method_assessment.cleanup_budget: One idempotent cleanup_remaining controller preserves the active monotonic deadline and supplies a strictly positive remaining allowance; no per-helper reset or fresh cleanup epoch is introduced. The controller remains available through pytest_runtest_teardown(nextitem=None), so function and session finalizers for the phase's last item are included. The installed pytest runner source confirms teardown_exact(None) tears down the full fixture stack. Abnormal sessionfinish cleanup remains failure recovery and cannot turn a timed-out case into a pass.
method_assessment.fixture_closure: The v2 closure explicitly includes DROP DATABASE connect/lock/statement bounds, HBA restore/reload, shared OIDC server/thread shutdown, both TestClient contexts and maintenance-task quiescence. H2-only maintenance cancellation before body keeps the production auth implementation unchanged and retains original auth/maintenance regressions. Timeouts preserve resource identities and fail when termination cannot be confirmed.
method_assessment.postgresql_identity: The current private data-directory postmaster PID and process start ticks are read after restarts; every stop/status/fallback uses the pinned pg_ctl and remaining shared allowance. Unknown/live state fails rather than claiming stopped.
method_assessment.attempt_order: Actual multi-generation rows remain complete and unchanged; deterministic generation ordering plus unique-generation assertions do not manufacture or normalize values and leave the frozen one-generation oracle untouched.
method_assessment.qualification_and_authorization: The full 407 retained IDs plus all 25 obligations, exact source review, fresh full gate, and independent ledger/contract/runner/pre-gate sequence remain mandatory. No test, import, collection, SQL, service, network, or runtime execution occurred.

historical_reviews.reason: V1 did not bind migration_db DROP DATABASE to the shared cleanup deadline; the v2 fixture-closure step addresses that finding and the other closure gaps identified by static audit.

execution_boundary: Approve authoring of the v2 shared fixture integration under its exact methods. This does not approve implementation, test/SQL/service execution, any individual H2 case, full H2 acceptance, or AT acceptance. Independent review of implementation, a fresh complete exact ledger/contract, reviewed runner and frozen pre-gate remain required before execution.
